entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I need to make a return. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly help you with a return. To get started, could you provide your order number and tell me what specifically is the issue with the item?
My order number is VF77812. It's the ProFit jersey. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I saved up for this. It's just... it's the wrong size.
Okay, thank you for that. When you say it's the wrong size, is it a technical fault with the material or more of a preference on the fit?

It's just too tight across the shoulders. I really thought a medium would work. I was hoping to do an exchange, but the large is sold out. I feel awful about it, and honestly, I really needed this money back for some unexpected bills.
I completely understand, and I'm sorry the fit wasn't perfect for you. Let me just pull up your order details... Okay, I see the order for the ProFit jersey was delivered 66 days ago.
Oh, has it been that long? I was so worried I missed the window. I just... I really can't afford to be out the money for something I can't even wear.

Not to worry at all. Our policy for standard items like this jersey allows for returns within 90 days. You are well within that timeframe. I can process a full refund for you right now and email you a pre-paid return label. How does that sound?
Really? Oh, thank you! That's such a huge relief. I was so stressed about this. Thank you so much, David.

You are very welcome. I've just sent that email with the return label to you. Once we receive the jersey, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thanks again.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
